I'm kinda trying to reach my protein goals while eating as cheaply as possible and clean as possible. You should be spending less than 10 bucks a day with these.

Meal 1 & 2

  • 1 cup oatmeal
  • 1 or 2 bananas
  • 1 L of milk (around 4 cups)
  • 1 spoon cocoa powder

Blend all of the ingredients and drink up. I usually let the oatmeal absorb the milk 10min.

Meal 3

  • 4 hard boiled eggs

Meal 4

  • Homemade food

This one is tricky because I don't cook in the afternoon. It could be chicken breast, pasta, soup, whatever. Something simple.

Meal 5

  • 2 cans of tuna (in water)
  • 3 slices of bread

Meal 6

  • 4 hard boiled eggs

Notes

  • Meal 4 can be replaced with meal 5, just add another can of tuna.
  • Regarding yolks, I have read a bit about cholesterol and some articles contradict each other so I'm playing it safe eating 2 or 3 per day.
  • I exercise daily, and to be honest don't know if these meals could apply to everyone.
  • Also these are kinda my guidelines, eat veggies, I didn't list any.
If anyone has any questions feel free to ask!
